other.purity: 99.9 mass% or higher for elemental Nb, Mo, W, Re, Si; 99.5% Nb-C powder

evidence.quote: These in-situ composites were prepared by conventional arc melting in an Ar atmosphere using elemental Nb, Mo, W, Re and Si with 99.9 mass% purity or higher, along with 99.5% Nb-C powder. The ingots were remelted five or six times to ensure chemical homogeneity.
